scope: Duel state machine and isolated DuelPage/Arena lifecycle only

fixture.profile: synthetic QWidget host with temporary local files

findings.issue: Late online search auto-start restarted the current mode without checking the original user intent
findings.fix: Pending-start request/mode/query/options identity; cancel on mode/options/hide/progress/new start

findings.issue: Persistence failure could escape before arena render and leave game/cards inconsistent
findings.fix: Keep live tournament responsive, retain in-memory state and show a save error

findings.issue: Malformed search response and partially missing title could raise from UI callback/champion screen
findings.fix: Validate callback shape, restore controls and convert champion title safely

findings.issue: Unreachable king history or duplicate-identity saved rosters passed session validation
findings.fix: Reject corrupt sessions transactionally without replacing a current game

verification.additional_targeted_check: Serialization TypeError/ValueError cannot interrupt start or vote; one added case and existing save-I/O case passed after the final guard change.

scenarios: cold empty library then files added, both start buttons
80 pair choices with save/restore and undo at each round
filters with zero matches then reset
late search after different local game/mode/options/query/hide/vote
empty-arena shortcuts while search is pending
partial track title on champion screen
limitations: Friend exact profile/saved state is unavailable. Header Start is not disabled by DuelPage and the candidate pool is read live at every start; a genuinely empty/unavailable library cannot start a new duel but existing progress is retained. No real media, audio, relays or live-display FPS were exercised.
